feeds.title: Association for Child & Adolescent Mental Health Blog
feeds.description: Covers ADHD Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder), Anxiety disorders, ASD (Autism Spectrum Disorders), Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, Depression, Intellectual Disabilities, OCD, Self-harm, and Suicide. The Association for Child and Adolescent Mental Health (ACAMH) provides information, training, and evidence to health professionals.

feeds.title: Children's Mental Health Ontario Blog
feeds.description: Children's Mental Health Ontario works to identify and develop solutions to important policy issues affecting the child and youth mental health sector. Read our latest CMHO blog posts for expert tips and resources for families with children and youth with mental health concerns.

feeds.title: Kids' Minds Matter Blog
feeds.description: Kids' Minds Matter raises awareness and essential funding to enhance pediatric mental & behavioral health programs and services in Southwest Florida.

feeds.title: Kids Matter
feeds.description: Kids Matter engages local churches to equip parents and carers facing disadvantages with confidence, competence, and community, enabling their children to thrive.

feeds.title: Hillside Blog
feeds.description: Hillside is one of Atlanta's oldest non-profit organizations, providing a continuum of mental health treatment services for young people with emotional, psychological, and behavioral challenges.

feeds.title: Indiana Center for the Prevention of Youth Abuse & Suicide Blog
feeds.description: They are committed to the prevention of youth abuse and suicide through high-quality, evidence-based prevention programs so all children can live free from harm and to their highest potential. Indiana Center for Prevention of Youth Abuse and Suicide is a nonprofit youth advocacy organization located in Central Indiana.

feeds.title: CYPMHC Blog
feeds.description: Covers Bereavement, Children and Young people's Mental health, Eating disorders, Mental health service, and Research. Campaigning on the mental health and wellbeing of children and young people.

feeds.title: Association for Children's Mental Health Blog
feeds.description: View the Association for Children's mental health blog. ACMH provides information, support, resources, referral, and advocacy for children and youth with mental, emotional, or behavioral disorders and their families. ACMH provides access to the services and information you need to get the right care for you and your child.

feeds.title: Child Therapy Blog
feeds.description: A blog for parents about play therapy, drama therapy, CBT, and counseling techniques for children coping with anxiety and trauma. Author Katie Lear has specialized in trauma & anxiety for children.

feeds.title: Kidthink Blog
feeds.description: Kidthink is a mental health treatment center and outreach program that focuses on improving mental health services for children in Manitoba.

feeds.title: Franciscan Children's Blog
feeds.description: News and insight from Franciscan about the philosophy of hope through healthcare and recent issues affecting children's wellness. They provide excellence in care for children with complex medical, mental health, and educational needs in a compassionate and positive environment.

feeds.title: Kidevolve Blog
feeds.description: Covers Kidshealth, Mindfulness, Anxiety, Self-regulation, Consciousparenting, Mental Health, and more. Kidevolve is a first-of-its-kind, customized mindfulness program developed just for kids between the ages of 6 and 10.

feeds.title: Quality Behavioral Health Blog
feeds.description: Quality Behavioral Health provides behavioral health services to children, adolescents, and adults who require assistance with their psychological and social needs. It is a medical management company providing complete management services to providers.

feeds.title: California Children's Trust Blog
feeds.description: The California Children's Trust is committed to working together to reinvent the state's approach towards children's social, emotional, and developmental health. The major focus is to improve child well-being through policy and systems reform.

feeds.title: Partners for Children's Mental Health Blog
feeds.description: Partners for Children's Mental Health (PCMH) is a center focused on improving the Children's mental health system in Colorado. PCMH operates as a cross-system resource, training, and implementation hub in order to ultimately increase the capacity, access, and quality of youth mental health services.

feeds.title: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention - Children's Mental Health
feeds.description: Childhood Mental health means reaching various milestones and learning healthy social skills and how to cope when there are problems. CDC is dedicated to protecting health & promoting quality of life.
